content.text:
I fixed the About page layout on phones. I haven't looked at it in a phone-width browser, so that part is untested. The functional tests pass (16 of 16), but they don't cover this layout.

**Cause:** the "How it started" section is a two-column grid (text plus a 480px image). The stylesheet already switches it to one column on screens 720px wide or narrower. But `site/css/pages.css` ended with a stray `.story { grid-template-columns: 1fr 480px; }` that came after that rule. It overrode the one-column layout, so on a phone the 480px image column squeezed the text and pushed the page wider than the screen.

**Fix:** I removed those 4 lines. The change is uncommitted in `site/css/pages.css`.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't check which change added the stray rule. I found it by reading the CSS.

STATUS: DONE
